prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Tocopherol content acts as an endogenous antioxidant in lipid-rich extracts, with higher initial tocopherol levels correlating strongly with extended stability under storage.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09783","field":"abstract","quote":"Tocopherol content in the same extracts acted as a partial endogenous antioxidant, delaying carotenoid oxidation: Pearson correlation between initial tocopherol content and lycopene half-life was 0.82."}]},{"text":"Nitrogen headspace and dark storage conditions substantially preserve lipid-soluble compounds during shelf storage, with nitrogen-packed dark conditions retaining 91–96% of total carotenoids over 12 weeks.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09783","field":"abstract","quote":"Nitrogen-packed dark storage best preserved total carotenoids across all extracts, with retention of 91–96% at week 12."}]},{"text":"The researcher has direct industry experience characterising tocopherol content and composition in cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil streams from regional producers.","sources":[{"id":"R0922","field":"industry_experience","quote":"She participated in an industry contract with a regional cold-press oil producer to characterise tocopherol content in press cake streams."}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has demonstrated expertise in tocopherol analysis and lipid stability under storage conditions [SYN-PUB-09783], and prior industry engagement with cold-press pumpkin producers [R0922], but published work focuses on extracted carotenoids and press cake valorisation rather than the specific oxidation pathways and peroxide value kinetics driving rancidity in bottled cold-pressed oils [SYN-PUB-09781, SYN-PUB-09780]."}
